title: SkyWatch
description: SkyWatch is the ultimate lightweight utility plugin designed for server staff and administrators.
body:
> SkyWatch is the ultimate lightweight utility plugin designed for server staff and administrators. With powerful tracking features and clean logging, SkyWatch provides real-time and historical data on player activity—right out of the box.

- 🔍 Track Player Sessions: Log every player's join and leave time.
-  🕒 Session Duration: Calculates how long players were online per session.
- 📁 Persistent Storage: Saves data in per-player .yml files inside a userdata/ folder.
- ⌨️ Simple Command Interface: Use /track <player> or /skytracker <player> to get detailed history.
- 🧾 Session Log Display: View all recorded sessions with timestamps and durations.
- 🧪 Lightweight and Fast: Minimal performance impact using optimized async I/O.
